prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling mountain campsite nestled among towering pines. On the left side of the composition, a tall pine tree stands with textured bark, its branches reaching upward. Leaning against this tree is a silver aluminum tent, its fabric slightly wrinkled from use. A woman in a blue beanie sits on a folding chair next to the tent, her posture relaxed as she holds a steaming mug. Beside her, a black backpack rests on the ground, its straps loosely coiled. In the center of the clearing, a crackling campfire burns within a ring of stones, sending thin wisps of smoke into the air. A man in a red scarf stands near the fire, pointing toward the distant peaks with his right hand. Looking at him intently is a child in a yellow jacket, who clutches a wooden stick. Sitting on a large log next to the child is a brown dog, its ears perked up attentively. To the right of the fire, a girl in green overalls is handing a marshmallow on a stick to a boy in an orange hat. The boy reaches out eagerly to accept the treat. Behind them, a stack of firewood lies neatly arranged, ready for the night. A gray cat sleeps peacefully on top of the woodpile, curled into a tight ball. Standing near the edge of the campsite is a hiking boot, muddy and worn. Next to the boot lies a crumpled map, partially unfolded. A lantern hangs from a low branch above the group, casting a soft glow. There is no modern technology visible in the scene. There is no vehicle present in the background.
